_comment: Documented exceptions to the npm audit gate. Each entry MUST have a justification + expiry. Past-expiry entries fail the build. See SUPPLY_CHAIN.md § Allowlist for the policy.
_policy: An entry exists because the fix is non-trivial (major-version bump with breaking changes, transitive in a build-only path, or no upstream fix yet). Each entry is a written commitment to revisit by the expiry date. The CI gate prints the days-to-expiry for every active entry as a forcing function.

exceptions.title: Next.js: HTTP request smuggling in rewrites + 5 related advisories
exceptions.justification: Fix requires `npm audit fix --force` which moves outside the stated dependency range and risks Next.js 16.2 regressions on `next start` standalone output. Requires a dedicated PR with full /api smoke verification per SECURITY.md § Fix SLAs (30 days for HIGH). Not bundled into WS6 supply-chain hardening to keep the gate-installation diff isolated and reviewable.
exceptions.tracking_issue: TBD — file follow-up `chore(source): bump next 16.1.6 -> 16.2.6 for CVE GHSA-ggv3-7p47-pfv8` after WS6 lands

exceptions.title: lodash vulnerable to Code Injection via `_.template` imports key names
exceptions.justification: Transitive dependency. Source does not call `_.template` directly. Will be cleared in the same follow-up PR as the next bump via `npm audit fix` (non-force).
exceptions.tracking_issue: TBD — covered by follow-up `chore(source): npm audit fix transitive HIGH/moderate vulns` after WS6 lands

exceptions.title: Picomatch: Method Injection in POSIX Character Classes + ReDoS via extglob quantifiers
exceptions.justification: Transitive dependency reachable only from build tooling (vitest, eslint glob expansion). Not on the request path of the running container. Will be cleared in the same follow-up PR via `npm audit fix` (non-force).
